integrity: The universal reset-word claim is proved symbolically. Exact power-automaton computations for small n are independent finite checks only and are not used as an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The result concerns the literal transition table printed in arXiv:1302.5793v2. It does not give a universal exact reset threshold for that literal automaton and does not challenge Theorem 4 for the distinct Figure-6/intended transition action.
title: A literal-definition reset-word obstruction in the \(E_n\) family
